name: OCC Sailing Youth Leadership Program
org: Orange Coast College School of Sailing and Seamanship
what_you_do: Teens learn teamwork and job skills in the summer sailing camps. This prepares you to be a camp counselor or assistant sailing instructor. You also study weather, tides and boating laws.
who_can_apply: You must be 14 years old or entering 9th grade. You need basic sailing skills and should enjoy working with children.
pay_detail: The fee is $525. Scholarships are available.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the program page. Check the class schedule on the online registration site.
how_to_apply: Check the class list and sign up online. For a scholarship, you must meet the eligibility requirements. Scholarship details are given at your interview. Call 949-645-9412 with questions.
notes: You can choose to take the written test for a Small Powerboat Certification. The program is at the OCC Waterfront Campus, 1801 West Coast Hwy, Newport Beach. The Summer Sailing Camps page gave the 2026 camp season as June 1 to August 7, 2026. It lists no dates for this program and no 2027 season.
